name: kubernetes
purpose: Project-local bounded observation plus separately enabled plan-bound namespaced create/update.
license: MIT for AIDE adapter; kubectl is Apache-2.0 and not redistributed
integrity: Frozen local uv projects; kubectl supplied by the operator
setup_steps: Verify the context and namespace derived from KUBECONFIG
Optionally create an ignored target override when explicit pinning is required
Keep the change server disabled until local policy and approvals are ready
health_check: Call aide_kubernetes_status and aide_kubernetes_change_status; then verify context through the observer

permissions.mutation: disabled by default; plan-bound namespaced server-side apply only
